name: Bvlgari Hotel Roma
insider_take: Where ancient Roman grandeur meets contemporary Italian luxury in the heart of the Eternal City.
whats_special: This ultra-luxe property occupies a magnificent 19th-century palazzo just steps from the Spanish Steps, featuring only 114 rooms and suites with breathtaking views of the Mausoleum of Augustus. The hotel's rooftop terrace offers one of Rome's most exclusive dining experiences with panoramic city views, while the spa incorporates precious gemstones in its treatments - a signature Bvlgari touch.
pro_tip: Book a suite facing Via dei Condotti for front-row seats to Rome's premier shopping district, and time your rooftop dinner reservation for sunset to witness the city's ancient monuments bathed in golden light.
dont_miss: The hotel's private access to exclusive shopping at nearby Bvlgari flagship store, and the Imperial Suite's private terrace overlooking the Mausoleum of Augustus - one of the most historically significant views in all of Rome. The underground Roman ruins discovered during construction are now beautifully integrated into the hotel's design.
pros: Iconic luxury brand with exquisite Italian design and jewelry heritage
Prime location in the heart of Rome near major attractions
Exceptional spa and wellness facilities with signature treatments
World-class dining experiences and rooftop restaurant
cons: Limited availability due to exclusive size
